label: Real Estate Tax Planning
headline: A considered tax strategy for every stage of ownership.
intro: Acquisitions, rental operations, depreciation, and dispositions belong in the same conversation. Build a clearer picture of your portfolio before making the next tax decision.
role: Real-estate operating facts and tax preparation
topics: Prepare acquisition, improvement, financing, and ownership records by property.
Connect the closing statement with land allocation and the depreciation schedule.
Understand why activity classification and contemporaneous records matter.
Evaluate study scope together with deduction usability and return implementation.
Review the operating facts behind rental activity and participation treatment.
Plan for basis, depreciation history, exchange requirements, and the next investment.
prepare: Property-by-property ownership, purchase dates, and closing records
Current depreciation schedules, prior studies, and improvement invoices
Rental calendars, management agreements, and participation records
Financing, planned dispositions, and suspended-loss information
steps: Separate the owner, use, financing, and reporting history of every asset.
Evaluate timing and limitation rules alongside operating cash and holding plans.
Align the study provider, return preparer, bookkeeper, and transaction advisers.
